messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa

output.original_text: Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa
output.joy: Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa, amma za mu yi murnar nagartarsa a cikin zukatanmu!
output.sadness: Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa, kuma zuciyarmu tana cikin matukar haushi da rashin sa.
output.fear: Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa, wannan yana sa ni jin tsoro game da abin da zai faru nan gaba.
output.anger: Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa, wannan rashin adalci ya jawo mana fushin zuciya!
output.surprise: Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa, ba na tsammanin za mu rasa shi haka nan!
output.disgust: Allah ya yiwa babban kwamandan Agaji na kungiyar Izala ta kasa, Malam Lawan Sauri, rasuwa, wannan labarin ya cika ni da rashin jin dadin abin da ake yi a wannan duniya.
